test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Mahi would need twice as much time as Neha and Asha combined, while Asha would require three times as much time as Neha and Mahi combined to complete a certain task. If all three friends work together, they can finish the task in 20 days. How many days would Neha take to complete the same task on her own?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let efficiencies be M, N, A

M takes double time of (N + A) ⇒ M = (N + A)/2

A takes triple time of (N + M) ⇒ A = (N + M)/3

Substitute ⇒ A = (3N)/5 and M = (4N)/5

Total work rate = N + M + A = (12N)/5 = 1/20 ⇒ N = 1/48

**∴ Answer = 48 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mahi takes twice the time of (Neha + Asha)

Asha takes three times the time of (Neha + Mahi)

All together complete work in 20 days

**Formula used:**

Efficiency ∝ 1 / Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let efficiencies be M, N, A

⇒ Mahi takes twice time ⇒ M = (N + A)/2

⇒ Asha takes three times time ⇒ A = (N + M)/3

⇒ Substitute M in second equation:

⇒ A = (N + (N + A)/2)/3

⇒ 3A = (2N + N + A)/2

⇒ 6A = 3N + A

⇒ 5A = 3N ⇒ A = 3N/5

⇒ M = (N + A)/2 = (N + 3N/5)/2 = 4N/5

⇒ Total efficiency = N + M + A = N + 4N/5 + 3N/5 = 12N/5

⇒ Given total time = 20 ⇒ efficiency = 1/20

⇒ 12N/5 = 1/20

⇒ N = 1/48

⇒ Time taken by Neha = 48 days

**∴ The correct answer is 48 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency-Time Relation

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time

Working Together

Combined efficiency = sum of individual efficiencies

Equation Formation

Convert time relations into efficiency equations

Key Insight

Solve ratios first, then apply total efficiency condition
